ucm_acm_faith_resolve_pick_group_effect = {
  remove_variable = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
  if = {
    limit = { has_variable = ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key }
    if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:tenet_peace_of_god

      add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = ucm_acm_fe_pick_current
        target = flag:doctrine_monasticism_encouraged
      }
      add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = ucm_acm_fe_pick_current
        target = flag:doctrine_monasticism_accepted
      }
      add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = ucm_acm_fe_pick_current
        target = flag:doctrine_monasticism_absent
      }
      add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = ucm_acm_fe_pick_current
        target = flag:doctrine_monasticism_forbidden
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { var:ucm_acm_pick_group_name = flag:sacraments_group }
      add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = ucm_acm_fe_pick_current
        target = flag:doctrine_sacraments_central
      }
      add_to_global_variable_list = {
        name = ucm_acm_fe_pick_current
        target = flag:doctrine_sacraments_absent
      }
    }
  }
}
